====================================================================================================
Casts of dates and timestamps

Each case runs as CAST. TRY_CAST follows a case only when CAST fails at runtime, to show which rows
become NULL. Where CAST succeeds, TRY_CAST is checked to return the same values and is not listed;
where CAST fails type checking, TRY_CAST is checked to fail it too.
====================================================================================================


----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Numbers and timestamps

An integer is a number of seconds, milliseconds or microseconds, by its magnitude: 315360000000 is
milliseconds and 315360000000000 microseconds. A value out of the timestamp range becomes the
minimum timestamp. A timestamp converts to its number of microseconds.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


ast            : CAST(-30610224000000001 AS TIMESTAMP)
raw expr       : CAST(-30610224000000001 AS Timestamp)
checked expr   : CAST<Int64>(-30610224000000001_i64 AS Timestamp)
optimized expr : -30610224000000001
output type    : Timestamp
output domain  : {-30610224000000001..=-30610224000000001}
output         : '0999-12-31 23:59:59.999999'


ast            : CAST(-315360000000000 AS TIMESTAMP)
raw expr       : CAST(-315360000000000 AS Timestamp)
checked expr   : CAST<Int64>(-315360000000000_i64 AS Timestamp)
optimized expr : -315360000000000
output type    : Timestamp
output domain  : {-315360000000000..=-315360000000000}
output         : '1960-01-04 00:00:00.000000'


ast            : CAST(-315360000000 AS TIMESTAMP)

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Numbers and dates

An integer is a number of days since 1970-01-01. A value out of the date range becomes the minimum
date, 0001-01-01, for CAST and TRY_CAST alike. A date converts to its number of days.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


ast            : CAST(-354286 AS DATE)
raw expr       : CAST(-354286 AS Date)
checked expr   : CAST<Int32>(-354286_i32 AS Date)
optimized expr : -354286
output type    : Date
output domain  : {-354286..=-354286}
output         : '0999-12-31'


ast            : CAST(-354285 AS DATE)
raw expr       : CAST(-354285 AS Date)
checked expr   : CAST<Int32>(-354285_i32 AS Date)
optimized expr : -354285
output type    : Date
output domain  : {-354285..=-354285}
output         : '1000-01-01'

checked expr   : CAST<Int8>(-100_i8 AS Date)
optimized expr : -100

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Dates and timestamps

A date converts to the timestamp at the start of its day, and a timestamp to the date of its day.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


ast            : CAST(TO_DATE(1) AS TIMESTAMP)
raw expr       : CAST(TO_DATE(1) AS Timestamp)
checked expr   : CAST<Date>(CAST<Int64>(CAST<UInt8>(1_u8 AS Int64) AS Date) AS Timestamp)
optimized expr : 86400000000
output type    : Timestamp
output domain  : {86400000000..=86400000000}
output         : '1970-01-02 00:00:00.000000'


ast            : CAST(TO_TIMESTAMP(1) AS DATE)
raw expr       : CAST(TO_TIMESTAMP(1) AS Date)
checked expr   : CAST<Timestamp>(CAST<Int64>(CAST<UInt8>(1_u8 AS Int64) AS Timestamp) AS Date)
optimized expr : 0
output type    : Date
output domain  : {0..=0}
output         : '1970-01-01'


ast            : CAST(a AS DATE)

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Strings and timestamps

A string parses as a date with an optional time and time zone offset; the offset converts the time
to the session time zone. A string that is not a timestamp fails. A timestamp renders with
microseconds.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


error: 
  --> SQL:1:1
  |
1 | TO_TIMESTAMP('2022')
  | ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ cannot parse to type `TIMESTAMP`. BadArguments. Code: 1006, Text = unexpected argument. while evaluating function `to_timestamp('2022')` in expr `CAST('2022' AS Timestamp)`



ast            : TRY_TO_TIMESTAMP('2022')
raw expr       : TRY_TO_TIMESTAMP('2022')
checked expr   : try_to_timestamp<String>("2022")
optimized expr : NULL
output type    : Timestamp NULL
output domain  : {NULL}
output         : NULL


error: 
  --> SQL:1:1

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Strings and dates

A string parses as a date. A time after the date is dropped, and its time zone offset does not move
the date. A date renders as `YYYY-MM-DD`.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


error: 
  --> SQL:1:1
  |
1 | TO_DATE('2022')
  | ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ cannot parse to type `DATE`. BadArguments. Code: 1006, Text = unexpected argument. while evaluating function `to_date('2022')` in expr `CAST('2022' AS Date)`
